lesion_mapping_status: Raw diagnoses are recoverable, but they cannot be linked reproducibly to one locked final-failed-screen denominator because the implemented repeat pathway diverged from the stated protocol and published accuracy tables use different positivity conventions.

poolability_reason: source is scientifically informative but the locked analytic unit—newborn after completion of the study repeat sequence—cannot be reconstructed as one reproducible denominator. Forcing either30 or60 would mix incompatible conventions.
